title: Project Overview
description: Start with the repository overview and contributor operating guide to understand Artio’s three surfaces, workflow rules, and architecture references.

title: Main App Entry and Shell
description: Inspect the main Flutter application entrypoint and top-level app shell to see how the primary client boots, configures providers, and connects routing.

title: Design System and Shared Core
description: Review shared core modules that provide design tokens, cross-cutting services, exceptions, and reusable state utilities used throughout the client surface.

title: Backend Edge Functions
description: Explore Supabase edge functions and shared helpers that implement generation orchestration, purchases, subscriptions, and reward flows on the server side.

title: Database and Policies
description: Study the SQL migration layer to understand how Artio models templates, profiles, credits, subscriptions, and access policies in Postgres.

title: Automation and Operations
description: Finish with repository automation, environment templates, and workflow artifacts that keep the project reproducible across local work, CI, and deployment.
